+"""Backend-agnostic pieces of the attention backend suites.
+
+- ``PagedBatch``: a reordered (decode, extend, prefill) batch with a unique
+  block per page, so a test can say which cache slots each request reads.
+- ``ref_attention``: float32 reference over logical (unpaged) K/V.
+- ``KernelSpy``: records which kernels a forward actually called.
+"""

+import math
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any

+@dataclass
+class PagedBatch:
+    """Requests in the order the runner's reorder pass produces them."""
+
+    query_lens: list[int]
+    seq_lens: list[int]
+    block_size: int
+    num_blocks: int
+    common: CommonAttentionMetadata
+    # Cache slot of every position 0..seq_len-1, per request.
+    slots: list[torch.Tensor]
+    # Cache slot of every query token, in token order.

+
+    @property
+    def num_tokens(self) -> int:
+        return sum(self.query_lens)
+
+    @property
+    def num_slots(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_blocks * self.block_size
+
+
+def blocks_needed(seq_lens: list[int], block_size: int) -> int:
+    return sum(math.ceil(s / block_size) for s in seq_lens)
+
+
+def make_paged_batch(
+    query_lens: list[int],
+    seq_lens: list[int],
+    block_size: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+    *,
+    num_blocks: int | None = None,
+    num_padded_tokens: int | None = None,
+    causal: bool = True,
+    seed: int = 0,
+) -> PagedBatch:
+    """Build metadata whose blocks are a random permutation (no aliasing).
+
+    Block-table rows are padded with block 0, as the model runner does.
+    ``num_padded_tokens`` > sum(query_lens) leaves trailing padding slots of
+    -1, as a CUDA-graph-padded batch does.
+    """
+    assert len(query_lens) == len(seq_lens)
+    assert all(0 < q <= s for q, s in zip(query_lens, seq_lens))
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    needed = blocks_needed(seq_lens, block_size)
+    num_blocks = num_blocks or needed + 1
+    assert num_blocks >= needed + 1
+    # Block 0 is reserved as the pad value and never holds a request's page.
+    perm = torch.randperm(num_blocks - 1, generator=gen)[:needed] + 1
+    max_blocks = max(math.ceil(s / block_size) for s in seq_lens)
+    block_table = torch.zeros(len(seq_lens), max_blocks, dtype=torch.int32)
+    slots, query_slots = [], []
+    cursor = 0
+    for i, (q, s) in enumerate(zip(query_lens, seq_lens)):
+        n = math.ceil(s / block_size)

+    num_heads = query.shape[1]
+    out = torch.empty(query.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
+    offset = 0
+    for q_len, seq_len, slots in zip(batch.query_lens, batch.seq_lens, batch.slots):
+        q_all = query[offset : offset + q_len].float()
+        k = k_all[slots].float()
+        v = v_all[slots].float()
+        group = num_heads // k.shape[1]
+        k = k.repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        v = v.repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        k_pos = torch.arange(seq_len, device=query.device)
+        for start in range(0, q_len, q_chunk):
+            q = q_all[start : start + q_chunk]
+            q_pos = torch.arange(
+                seq_len - q_len + start,
+                seq_len - q_len + start + q.shape[0],
+                device=query.device,
+            )
+            logits = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", q, k) * scale
+            if logits_soft_cap:
+                logits = logits_soft_cap * torch.tanh(logits / logits_soft_cap)
+            rel = k_pos[None, :] - q_pos[:, None]
+            if alibi_slopes is not None:
+                logits = logits + alibi_slopes.float()[:, None, None] * rel[None]
+            mask = torch.ones_like(rel, dtype=torch.bool)
+            if causal:
+                mask &= rel <= 0
+            if sliding_window is not None:
+                mask &= rel > -sliding_window
+            logits = logits.masked_fill(~mask[None], float("-inf"))
+            if sinks is not None:
+                sink_col = sinks.float()[:, None, None].expand(-1, q.shape[0], 1)
+                probs = torch.softmax(torch.cat([logits, sink_col], dim=-1), -1)
+                probs = probs[..., :-1]
+            else:
+                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
+            out[offset + start : offset + start + q.shape[0]] = torch.einsum(
+                "hqk,khd->qhd", probs, v
+            )
+        offset += q_len
+    return out
+
+
+@dataclass
+class KernelSpy:
+    """Wraps kernels so a test can assert which ones a forward called."""
+
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+    calls: list[tuple[str, tuple, dict[str, Any]]] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    def watch(self, owner: Any, attr: str, name: str | None = None) -> None:
+        original: Callable = getattr(owner, attr)
+        label = name or attr
+
+        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
+            self.calls.append((label, args, kwargs))
+            return original(*args, **kwargs)
+
+        self.monkeypatch.setattr(owner, attr, wrapper)
+
+    def names(self) -> list[str]:
+        return [name for name, _, _ in self.calls]
+
+    def kwargs_of(self, name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return [kw for n, _, kw in self.calls if n == name]
+
+    def args_of(self, name: str) -> list[tuple]:
+        return [args for n, args, _ in self.calls if n == name]
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        self.calls.clear()

+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+# Non-unit so a missing scale shows up as a numerical error.
+FP8_K_SCALE = 0.5
+FP8_V_SCALE = 0.25
+
+FP8_ATOL = 6e-2
+FP8_RTOL = 1e-1
+FP8_MAX_BAD_FRACTION = 2e-3
+FP8_MAX_ABS = 0.3
+
+# Kernel labels used by the dispatch tests.
+VARLEN = "flash_attn_varlen_func"
+GATHER = "cp_mha_gather_cache"
+MERGE = "merge_attn_states"

+PAGED_COMMON = "paged_attention_common"

+
+def tolerance(dtype: torch.dtype, kv_cache_dtype: str) -> dict[str, float]:
+    if is_quantized_kv_cache(kv_cache_dtype):
+        return {"atol": 6e-2, "rtol": 1e-1}
+    if dtype == torch.float16:
+        return {"atol": 1e-2, "rtol": 1e-2}
+    return {"atol": 2e-2, "rtol": 2e-2}
+
+
+def make_config(
+    shape: AttnShape,
+    *,
+    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
+    kv_cache_dtype: str = "auto",
+    block_size: int = 16,
+    num_blocks: int = 1024,
+    max_model_len: int = 16384,
+    max_num_seqs: int = 256,
+    max_num_batched_tokens: int = 16384,
+) -> VllmConfig:
+    """A VllmConfig whose attention dims are the given model's."""
+    model_config = ModelConfig(
+        model="Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B",
+        dtype=dtype,
+        seed=0,
+        max_model_len=max_model_len,
+        hf_overrides={
+            "num_attention_heads": shape.num_heads,
+            "num_key_value_heads": shape.num_kv_heads,
+            "head_dim": shape.head_size,
+            "max_position_embeddings": max_model_len,
+        },
+    )
+    cache_config = CacheConfig(block_size=block_size, cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype)
+    cache_config.num_gpu_blocks = num_blocks
+    cache_config.num_cpu_blocks = 0
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model_config,
+        cache_config=cache_config,
+        scheduler_config=SchedulerConfig(
+            max_num_seqs=max_num_seqs,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
+            max_model_len=max_model_len,
+            is_encoder_decoder=False,
+        ),
+    )

+def watch_all_kernels(spy: KernelSpy) -> None:
+    """Spy on every kernel AiterFlashAttentionImpl can dispatch to."""
+    import importlib
+
+    import aiter  # noqa: F401  # registers torch.ops.aiter
+
+    # import_module, not `import a.b.c as m`: aiter's package __init__ re-exports
+    # functions under the same names as their modules.
+    mha_v3 = importlib.import_module("aiter.ops.triton.attention.mha_v3")
+    # The backend imports unified_attention by its old path, which aiter's
+    # import shim maps to attention.unified_attention by loading the file a
+    # second time under the old name, so there are two module objects with
+    # their own function. Patch both.
+    importlib.import_module("aiter.ops.triton.unified_attention")
+    unified_modules = {
+        id(m): m
+        for m in (
+            sys.modules["aiter.ops.triton.unified_attention"],
+            importlib.import_module("aiter.ops.triton.attention.unified_attention"),
+        )
+    }.values()

+    spy.watch(rocm_aiter_ops, "paged_attention_common", PAGED_COMMON)
+    spy.watch(rocm_aiter_fa, "cp_mha_gather_cache", GATHER)
+    spy.watch(rocm_aiter_fa, "merge_attn_states", MERGE)
+    spy.watch(rocm_aiter_fa, "reshape_and_cache_shuffle_triton", WRITE_SHUFFLE)
+    spy.watch(torch.ops.aiter, "paged_attention_v1", PAGED_V1)
+    spy.watch(torch.ops._C_cache_ops, "reshape_and_cache_flash", WRITE_FLASH)
+    for unified in unified_modules:
+        spy.watch(unified, "unified_attention", UNIFIED)
+    spy.watch(mha_v3, "flash_attn_with_kvcache", MHA_V3)

+@dataclass
+class FaCase:
+    shape: AttnShape
+    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    kv_cache_dtype: str = "auto"
+    block_size: int = 16
+    sliding_window: int | None = None
+    logits_soft_cap: float | None = None
+    # None: take it from the shape (GPT-OSS layers have sinks).
+    use_sinks: bool | None = None
+    use_alibi: bool = False
+    kv_sharing: bool = False
+    layout: KVCacheLayout | None = None
+    max_model_len: int = 16384
+    max_num_seqs: int = 256
+    max_num_batched_tokens: int = 16384
+    num_blocks: int = 0
+    seed: int = 0

+    layers: dict[str, Attention] = field(init=False)
+    builder: AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder = field(init=False)
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor = field(init=False)
+    k_all: torch.Tensor = field(init=False)
+    v_all: torch.Tensor = field(init=False)
+
+    @property
+    def scale(self) -> float:
+        return self.shape.head_size**-0.5
+
+    @property
+    def layer(self) -> Attention:
+        """The layer under test: the sharing layer when KV is shared."""
+        return self.layers["shared" if self.kv_sharing else "target"]
+

+        self.config = make_config(
+            self.shape,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+            kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            block_size=self.block_size,
+            num_blocks=num_blocks,
+            max_model_len=self.max_model_len,
+            max_num_seqs=self.max_num_seqs,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=self.max_num_batched_tokens,
+        )
+        h, kv, d = self.shape.num_heads, self.shape.num_kv_heads, self.shape.head_size
+        extra = {}
+        if self.use_sinks:
+            extra["sinks"] = torch.randn(h, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)
+        alibi = [2 ** (-8 * (i + 1) / h) for i in range(h)] if self.use_alibi else None
+        self.layers = {}
+        # The model loader builds layers under the target device.
+        with set_current_vllm_config(self.config), torch.device(DEVICE):
+            names = ["target", "shared"] if self.kv_sharing else ["target"]
+            for name in names:
+                self.layers[name] = Attention(
+                    h,
+                    d,
+                    self.scale,
+                    kv,
+                    alibi_slopes=alibi,
+                    cache_config=self.config.cache_config,
+                    logits_soft_cap=self.logits_soft_cap,
+                    per_layer_sliding_window=self.sliding_window,
+                    prefix=name,

+                        "target" if name == "shared" else None
+                    ),
+                    attn_backend=AiterFlashAttentionBackend,
+                    **extra,
+                )
+            spec = AiterFlashAttentionBackend.customize_spec(
+                FullAttentionSpec(
+                    block_size=self.block_size,
+                    num_kv_heads=kv,
+                    head_size=d,
+                    dtype=self.layers["target"].kv_cache_torch_dtype,
+                    kv_quant_mode=get_kv_quant_mode(self.kv_cache_dtype),
+                )
+            )

+                spec, names, self.config, DEVICE
+            )

+            self.layout or AiterFlashAttentionBackend.supported_kv_cache_layouts()[0]
+        )

+            num_blocks * spec.page_size_bytes, dtype=torch.int8, device=DEVICE
+        )

+            raw, spec, num_blocks, num_layers=1, layout=layout
+        )

+        for layer in self.layers.values():
+            layer.kv_cache = self.kv_cache
+            k_scale = FP8_K_SCALE if quantized else 1.0
+            v_scale = FP8_V_SCALE if quantized else 1.0
+            layer._k_scale.fill_(k_scale)
+            layer._v_scale.fill_(v_scale)
+            layer._k_scale_float = k_scale
+            layer._v_scale_float = v_scale
+            layer._k_scale_cpu = torch.tensor(k_scale, dtype=torch.float32)

+
+    def _representable(self, x: torch.Tensor, scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Round K/V to values the cache stores exactly, so the reference and
+        the kernel see the same K/V and only accumulation error remains."""
+        if not is_quantized_kv_cache(self.kv_cache_dtype):
+            return x
+        fp8 = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+        return ((x / scale).to(fp8).to(x.dtype) * scale).to(x.dtype)
+
+    def _fill_cache(self) -> None:
+        num_slots = self.num_blocks * self.block_size
+        kv, d = self.shape.num_kv_heads, self.shape.head_size
+        k = torch.randn(num_slots, kv, d, dtype=self.dtype, device=DEVICE)
+        v = torch.randn(num_slots, kv, d, dtype=self.dtype, device=DEVICE)
+        self.k_all = self._representable(k, FP8_K_SCALE)
+        self.v_all = self._representable(v, FP8_V_SCALE)
+        target = self.layers["target"]
+        target.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+            target,
+            self.k_all,
+            self.v_all,
+            self.kv_cache,
+            torch.arange(num_slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=DEVICE),
+        )
+
+    def batch(
+        self,
+        query_lens: list[int],
+        seq_lens: list[int],
+        *,
+        num_padded_tokens: int | None = None,
+        causal: bool = True,
+    ) -> PagedBatch:
+        return make_paged_batch(
+            query_lens,
+            seq_lens,
+            self.block_size,
+            DEVICE,
+            num_blocks=self.num_blocks,
+            num_padded_tokens=num_padded_tokens,
+            causal=causal,
+            seed=self.seed,
+        )
+
+    def build(self, batch: PagedBatch) -> AiterFlashAttentionMetadata:
+        return self.builder.build(0, batch.common)
+
+    def query(self, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return torch.randn(
+            num_tokens,
+            self.shape.num_heads,
+            self.shape.head_size,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+            device=DEVICE,
+        )
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        batch: PagedBatch,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        metadata: AiterFlashAttentionMetadata | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Forward the layer under test; returns [num_tokens, H, D]."""
+        metadata = metadata if metadata is not None else self.build(batch)
+        n = query.shape[0]
+        key = value = None
+        if not self.kv_sharing:
+            key = torch.zeros(
+                n,
+                self.shape.num_kv_heads,
+                self.shape.head_size,
+                dtype=self.dtype,
+                device=DEVICE,
+            )
+            value = torch.zeros_like(key)
+            key[: batch.num_tokens] = self.k_all[batch.query_slots]
+            value[: batch.num_tokens] = self.v_all[batch.query_slots]
+        output = torch.full_like(query, float("nan"))
+        layer = self.layer
+        layer.impl.forward(layer, query, key, value, self.kv_cache, metadata, output)
+        return output
+
+    def reference(self, batch: PagedBatch, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        impl = self.layer.impl
+        return ref_attention(
+            query[: batch.num_tokens],
+            self.k_all,
+            self.v_all,
+            batch,
+            self.scale,
+            sliding_window=self.sliding_window,
+            causal=bool(batch.common.causal),
+            logits_soft_cap=self.logits_soft_cap or 0.0,
+            sinks=impl.sinks,
+            alibi_slopes=impl.alibi_slopes,
+        )
+
+    def check(self, batch: PagedBatch, query: torch.Tensor, output: torch.Tensor):
+        expected = self.reference(batch, query)
+        actual = output[: batch.num_tokens].float()
+        assert torch.isfinite(actual).all(), "non-finite attention output"
+        if not is_quantized_kv_cache(self.kv_cache_dtype):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                actual, expected, **tolerance(self.dtype, self.kv_cache_dtype)
+            )
+            return
+        # The fp8 decode kernels lose more precision than the K/V rounding
+        # the reference already models (up to ~0.2 abs at 2-3 token contexts
+        # on MI355, shrinking with context length). Bound the bulk tightly and
+        # the worst element loosely, so a broken scale still fails.
+        err = (actual - expected).abs()
+        bad = (err > FP8_ATOL + FP8_RTOL * expected.abs()).float().mean().item()
+        assert bad <= FP8_MAX_BAD_FRACTION, f"{bad:.2%} elements out of tolerance"
+        assert err.max().item() <= FP8_MAX_ABS, f"max abs error {err.max():.3f}"
+
+
+def blocks_for(seq_lens: list[int], block_size: int, slack: int = 8) -> int:
+    return sum(-(-s // block_size) for s in seq_lens) + slack
+
+
+def set_shuffle(monkeypatch, enabled: bool) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm_aiter_ops, "_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_ENABLED", enabled)

+"""ROCM_AITER_FA output vs a float32 reference over flagship model shapes.
+
+Dimensions: model shape (head size, H/KV, TP-sharded heads, sliding window)
+x phase (prefill / extend / decode / mixed) x tokens per request (1, 2048,
+4096, 8192) x requests per batch (1, 16, 128) x block size (16, 32) x KV
+dtype (auto, fp8). Pre-merge runs a covering set where every value of each
+dimension meets every phase; ``-m slow_test`` runs the full product.
+
+Prefill and extend batches are capped at ``TOKEN_BUDGET`` new tokens, as the
+scheduler's max_num_batched_tokens would cap them; requests beyond the budget
+become decodes over the same context, which is what a running batch holds.
+"""
+
+import itertools
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa.fa_harness import FaCase, blocks_for
+from tests.v1.attention.model_shapes import (
+    GEMMA4_31B_SLIDING,
+    MUSE_SPARK_SLIDING,
+    AttnShape,
+    dense_rank_shapes,
+    shapes_supported_by,
+)
+
+SUPPORTED_HEAD_SIZES = [64, 128, 256]
+SHAPES = shapes_supported_by(SUPPORTED_HEAD_SIZES)
+PHASES = ["prefill", "extend", "decode", "mixed"]
+TOKENS = [1, 2048, 4096, 8192]
+BATCHES = [1, 16, 128]
+BLOCK_SIZES = [16, 32]
+KV_DTYPES = ["auto", "fp8"]
+TOKEN_BUDGET = 16384
+EXTEND_CHUNK = 512
+
+
+def make_lens(phase: str, tokens: int, batch: int) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+    """(query_lens, seq_lens) in reorder order: decodes, extends, prefills."""
+    if phase == "decode":
+        return [1] * batch, [tokens] * batch
+    if phase == "prefill":
+        n = max(1, min(batch, TOKEN_BUDGET // tokens))
+        return [1] * (batch - n) + [tokens] * n, [tokens] * batch
+    if phase == "extend":
+        chunk = max(1, min(EXTEND_CHUNK, tokens - 1, TOKEN_BUDGET // batch))
+        if tokens == 1:
+            return [1] * batch, [1] * batch
+        return [chunk] * batch, [tokens] * batch
+    # mixed: half decodes, a quarter extends, the rest prefills (>= 1 each).
+    n_dec = max(1, batch // 2) if batch > 1 else 0
+    n_ext = max(1, batch // 4) if batch > 2 else 0
+    n_pre = batch - n_dec - n_ext
+    pre_len = max(1, min(tokens, TOKEN_BUDGET // (2 * max(n_pre, 1))))
+    ext_q = max(1, min(EXTEND_CHUNK, tokens - 1)) if tokens > 1 else 1
+    q = [1] * n_dec + [ext_q] * n_ext + [pre_len] * n_pre
+    s = [tokens] * n_dec + [tokens] * n_ext + [pre_len] * n_pre
+    if tokens == 1:
+        s = [max(x, 2) if i < n_dec else x for i, x in enumerate(s)]
+    return q, s
+
+
+def _run(
+    shape: AttnShape,
+    phase,
+    tokens,
+    batch,
+    block_size,
+    kv_cache_dtype,
+    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+):
+    query_lens, seq_lens = make_lens(phase, tokens, batch)
+    case = FaCase(
+        shape,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
+        block_size=block_size,
+        sliding_window=shape.sliding_window,
+        max_model_len=max(16384, max(seq_lens)),
+        max_num_batched_tokens=max(TOKEN_BUDGET, sum(query_lens)),
+    ).setup(blocks_for(seq_lens, block_size))
+    batch_ = case.batch(query_lens, seq_lens)
+    query = case.query(batch_.num_tokens)
+    case.check(batch_, query, case.run(batch_, query))
+
+
+def _covering_set():
+    """Each (tokens, batch) pair with each phase once; the shape, block size
+    and KV dtype rotate so each of them appears across the set."""
+    cases = []
+    for i, (phase, tokens, batch) in enumerate(
+        itertools.product(PHASES, TOKENS, BATCHES)
+    ):
+        shape = SHAPES[i % len(SHAPES)]
+        cases.append(
+            pytest.param(
+                shape,
+                phase,
+                tokens,
+                batch,
+                BLOCK_SIZES[i % 2],
+                KV_DTYPES[(i // 2) % 2],
+                id=f"{shape.id}-{phase}-t{tokens}-b{batch}-bs{BLOCK_SIZES[i % 2]}"
+                f"-{KV_DTYPES[(i // 2) % 2]}",
+            )
+        )
+    return cases
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "shape, phase, tokens, batch, block_size, kv_cache_dtype", _covering_set()

+

+"""Full-graph capture and replay of ROCM_AITER_FA's decode path.
+
+The builder declares ``UNIFORM_BATCH``: FULL_DECODE_ONLY and
+FULL_AND_PIECEWISE capture uniform decode batches (q_len 1, or 1 + spec
+tokens) as full graphs. This mirrors the runner: metadata tensors live in
+persistent buffers, capture uses ``build_for_cudagraph_capture`` with
+``max_seq_len = max_model_len``, and every replay rebuilds metadata into the
+same buffers with different sequence lengths and block tables. Mode-level
+behavior (NONE / PIECEWISE / FULL_DECODE_ONLY / FULL_AND_PIECEWISE through the
+runner) is in tests/v1/e2e/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa_runtime.py.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa.fa_harness import (
+    DEVICE,
+    FaCase,
+    set_shuffle,
+)
+from tests.v1.attention.model_shapes import (
+    MUSE_SPARK_SLIDING,
+    QWEN3_8_27B,
+    QWEN3_235B,
+)
+
+MAX_MODEL_LEN = 4096
+NUM_REQS = 8
+
+
+def _capture_and_replay(case: FaCase, q_len: int, replays: list[list[int]]):
+    max_blocks = MAX_MODEL_LEN // case.block_size
+    capture = case.batch([q_len] * NUM_REQS, [MAX_MODEL_LEN] * NUM_REQS)
+    common = capture.common
+    common.max_seq_len = MAX_MODEL_LEN
+    assert common.block_table_tensor.shape[1] == max_blocks
+    num_tokens = q_len * NUM_REQS
+    query = case.query(num_tokens)
+    key = torch.zeros(
+        num_tokens,
+        case.shape.num_kv_heads,
+        case.shape.head_size,
+        dtype=case.dtype,
+        device=DEVICE,
+    )
+    value = torch.zeros_like(key)
+    output = torch.empty_like(query)
+    layer = case.layer
+    metadata = case.builder.build_for_cudagraph_capture(common)
+
+    def step():

+EPS = 1e-6

+def _rope_ref(x, positions, cos_sin_cache, is_neox):
+    """x: [T, H, D] float32; rotates the first rotary_dim channels."""
+    rot = cos_sin_cache.shape[-1]
+    cos, sin = cos_sin_cache[positions].float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    cos, sin = cos[:, None, :], sin[:, None, :]
+    xr, xp = x[..., :rot], x[..., rot:]
+    if is_neox:
+        x1, x2 = xr.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        out = torch.cat([x1 * cos - x2 * sin, x2 * cos + x1 * sin], dim=-1)
+    else:
+        x1, x2 = xr[..., 0::2], xr[..., 1::2]
+        out = torch.stack([x1 * cos - x2 * sin, x2 * cos + x1 * sin], dim=-1)
+        out = out.flatten(-2)
+    return torch.cat([out, xp], dim=-1)
+
+
+def _rms_ref(x, weight):
+    x = x.float()
+    return x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS) * weight.float()

+    if not is_quantized_kv_cache(kv_cache_dtype):

+    """K/V at ``slots``, dequantized, through the backend's own gather kernel

+    impl = case.layer.impl

+    assert md.num_actual_tokens == sum(query_lens)

+"""Buffers ROCM_AITER_FA allocates, and that each is used by its config.

+change in their size is a visible diff rather than a silent memory regression.

+def _nbytes(t: torch.Tensor | None) -> int:

+    if swa:

+    if sharing:
+        assert b.kv_sharing_workspace.shape == (

+        )
+    # Every builder holds the chunked-context gather buffer.
+    assert b.extend_workspace.shape == (

+def _decode_workspace_bytes(num_seqs, num_heads, head_size, max_seq_len, elem):
+    partitions = -(-max_seq_len // _PARTITION_SIZE_ROCM)
+    return (
+        num_seqs * num_heads * partitions * head_size * elem
+        + 2 * num_seqs * num_heads * partitions * 4

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_seq_len", [512, 4096])
+def test_decode_transient_allocation_matches_formula(max_seq_len, monkeypatch):
+    """paged_attention_v1's partition workspace is allocated per forward and
+    sized by metadata.max_seq_len (max_model_len during graph capture)."""
+    set_shuffle(monkeypatch, False)
+    num_seqs = 16
+    seq_lens = [max_seq_len] * num_seqs
+    case = FaCase(QWEN3_235B, max_model_len=max_seq_len).setup(blocks_for(seq_lens, 16))
+    batch = case.batch([1] * num_seqs, seq_lens)
+    query = case.query(num_seqs)
+    metadata = case.build(batch)
+    case.run(batch, query, metadata)  # JIT warm-up
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
+    base = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
+    case.run(batch, query, metadata)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    transient = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() - base
+    expected = _decode_workspace_bytes(
+        num_seqs, QWEN3_235B.num_heads, QWEN3_235B.head_size, max_seq_len, 2
+    )
+    # Output/key/value buffers of run() account for the rest.
+    io_bytes = 3 * _nbytes(query)
+    assert expected <= transient <= expected + io_bytes + (1 << 20)
+

+"""Attention-layer shapes of current flagship models, for backend test matrices.
+
+Values are copied from each model's Hugging Face ``config.json`` (read on
+2026-10-24). Only models whose layers run through a dense MHA/GQA backend are
+listed; MLA and sparse-attention models (DeepSeek V3/V3.2/V4/V4.1, GLM-5.x,
+Kimi K3, MiniMax M3's sparse layers) belong to the MLA/sparse backend suites.
+Re-read the configs rather than hand-editing a number.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AttnShape:
+    """One attention layer kind of one model, at a given TP degree."""
+
+    model: str
+    num_heads: int
+    num_kv_heads: int
+    head_size: int
+    sliding_window: int | None = None
+    tp: int = 1
+    sinks: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def id(self) -> str:
+        name = self.model.split("/")[-1]
+        window = f"-swa{self.sliding_window}" if self.sliding_window else ""
+        sinks = "-sinks" if self.sinks else ""
+        return (
+            f"{name}-tp{self.tp}-h{self.num_heads}kv{self.num_kv_heads}"
+            f"d{self.head_size}{window}{sinks}"
+        )
+
+    def shard(self, tp: int) -> "AttnShape":
+        """Per-rank shape; KV heads are replicated once tp exceeds them."""
+        assert self.num_heads % tp == 0
+        return AttnShape(
+            self.model,
+            self.num_heads // tp,
+            max(self.num_kv_heads // tp, 1),
+            self.head_size,
+            self.sliding_window,
+            tp,
+            self.sinks,
+        )
+

+"""ROCM_AITER_FA through the engine: scheduler, model runners, graphs.

+weights (attention dims unchanged, everything else shrunk) and compares its
+logprobs with the same model on TRITON_ATTN under the same engine settings.

+- GPT-OSS-20B: sliding (128) + full layer, both with attention sinks.

+(prefix-cache hits -> extends) and decode steps, so every phase runs under:
+
+- CUDA graph mode: NONE, PIECEWISE, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
+- async scheduling on/off
+- model runner v1 / v2
+- KV cache dtype auto / fp8
